data.description:
Discovered while authoring Cloud config-validation coverage for story 2127-348c-c41d-472e.

_build_jira_backend (src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira/backend.py) resolves settings via resolve_jira_settings (which returns "" for a missing url/user/api_token) and constructs the AcliClient transport WITHOUT asserting the credentials are present. assert_transport_conforms only checks method/protocol conformance, not credentials. So a wholly-unconfigured Cloud environment builds a live-looking backend that fails only later, at the first real API call, instead of failing loudly at construction.

Pinned as current behaviour by tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_cloud_config_validation.py::test_cloud_build_backend_with_missing_credentials_does_not_fail_loudly (absence-documenting). Mirrors bug cd78's shape on the Cloud direction.

Acceptance: _build_jira_backend raises a clear configuration error when url/user/api_token are absent; flip the absence-doc test to assert the loud failure.
data.title: Cloud _build_jira_backend builds a transport with missing credentials without failing loudly
